sessions.title: Document WA assessment requirements
sessions.summary: In the education warehouse silver star schema, 'active students each school year' is COUNT(DISTINCT student_sk) from silver.fact_enrolment grouped by academic_year. Do not confuse total historical students in dim_student (~1.6k) with active students per academic_year. academic_year is derived on silver load as entry_calendar_year + (class.year_level - student.year_level); enrolment grain is (student_sk, class_sk, academic_year). Always join on surrogate *_sk keys, not school-supplied natural ids.

sessions.title: Refactor dashboard profiles to creators
sessions.summary: Seeded scrape_targets from existing DuckDB data: 2263 posts, 401 distinct owners collapsed into 154 tracked profiles (55 previous dim_profile + 63 multi-post + 36 viral single-post; 247 long-tail singles skipped). Depth equals number of posts already held per profile, no tiers. Repaired reset_watermarks in src/datalake/cli/_state.py to use ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE instead of DELETE+reinsert, preventing profiles_ig watermark loss and full avatar re-downloads. Confirmed likes sentinel semantics: -1=Apify hidden/unavailable, NULL=absent, 0=real zero; seed treats -1 as missing and never as zero. Approved creators/profiles spec at tasks/plans/creators-and-profiles.md: 10 stories, 11 edge cases, binary DoD; creator name backfill uses first profile name, /creators keyed by integer id. Repo is on feat/profile-management with uncommitted _state.py, scripts/seed_scrape_targets.py, data/seed_scrape_targets.csv. Known hardening gaps: ig_posts_slv does not write silver_ig watermark; silver_ig/gold_ig stuck at 1970-01-02; silver stores -1 likes raw; enrichment 21/2263.

sessions.title: Find database role with full admin access
sessions.summary: Neon gold tables were not actually missing: the edu_writer role does not have privileges on the gold schema. Use the owner/admin DSN (NEON_OWNER_DSN / local superuser) to inspect or administer the whole DB; role/schema model lives in warehouse/migrations/001_schemas_roles.sql. Separately, pbix_mcp template bug: columns are written with IsAvailableInMDX=0, disabling attribute hierarchies and causing hierarchy creation failures plus misleading DirectQuery errors. Fix is IsAvailableInMDX=1 on all columns and regenerating the .pbit/.pbix template.

sessions.title: Find free SQL GUI clients
sessions.summary: User is selecting a free SQL GUI client that supports DuckDB without a paywall, plus data lake file browsing and PostgreSQL. Beekeeper Studio gates DuckDB behind an upgrade. Best free recommendation is DBeaver Community; DbGate is the modern-UI alternative, Duck-UI is a DuckDB-native browser workbench, HeidiSQL is Windows-native, and DB Browser for SQLite is only a compatibility fallback.
